targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((MAX(ts_session_ms::bigint) - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint)) / 1000.0::numeric, 1) AS duration_s FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km'))::numeric, 2) AS distance_km FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS energy_wh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND((d.dist_km / NULLIF(d.energy_kwh, 0))::numeric, 1) AS eff_km_per_kwh FROM (SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') AS dist_km, (MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600000.0 AS energy_kwh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours')) d;

SELECT ROUND((d.dist_km / NULLIF((d.duration_s / 3600.0), 0))::numeric, 1) AS avg_speed_kmh FROM (SELECT MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') AS dist_km, (MAX(ts_session_ms::bigint) - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint)) / 1000.0 AS duration_s FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours')) d;

SELECT ROUND(MAX(value)::numeric, 1) AS max_speed_kmh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours');

SELECT ROUND(AVG(v * i)::numeric, 0) AS avg_power_w FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') AS v, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS i FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) p;

SELECT ROUND(MAX(v * i)::numeric, 0) AS peak_power_w FROM (SELECT time_bucket('1s', time) AS bucket, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Voltage_780') AS v, AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Current_780') AS i FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Current_780') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1) p;

SELECT to_timestamp((ts_session_ms::bigint - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint) OVER (PARTITION BY lap_number)) / 1000.0) AS "time", ('Lap ' || lap_number::text) AS metric, value::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh' AND lap_number IS NOT NULL AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') ORDER BY lap_number::int, ts_session_ms::bigint;

SELECT to_timestamp(ts_session_ms::bigint / 1000.0) AS "time", value::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') ORDER BY ts_session_ms::bigint;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name IN ('Voltage_780', 'Voltage_740') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name IN ('Current_780', 'Current_740') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', time) AS "time", signal_name AS metric, AVG(value)::double precision AS value FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name IN ('Throttle_Percent', 'Brake_Active') AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT lap, duration_s, distance_km, energy_wh, avg_speed_kmh, max_speed_kmh, eff_km_per_kwh, ROUND((duration_s - MIN(duration_s) OVER ())::numeric, 1) AS delta_s_vs_best FROM (SELECT lap_number::int AS lap, ROUND((MAX(ts_session_ms::bigint) - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint)) / 1000.0::numeric, 1) AS duration_s, ROUND((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km'))::numeric, 2) AS distance_km, ROUND(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS energy_wh, ROUND(AVG(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh')::numeric, 1) AS avg_speed_kmh, ROUND(MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Speed_Kmh')::numeric, 1) AS max_speed_kmh, ROUND(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Distance_Km')) / NULLIF(((MAX(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780') - MIN(value) FILTER (WHERE signal_name = 'Joules_780')) / 3600000.0), 0))::numeric, 1) AS eff_km_per_kwh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND lap_number IS NOT NULL AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') GROUP BY lap_number::int) t ORDER BY lap;

SELECT to_timestamp((ts_session_ms::bigint - MIN(ts_session_ms::bigint) OVER (PARTITION BY lap_number)) / 1000.0) AS "time", ('Lap ' || lap_number::text) AS metric, ((value - MIN(value) OVER (PARTITION BY lap_number)) / 3600.0)::double precision AS energy_wh FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND signal_name = 'Joules_780' AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') ORDER BY ts_session_ms::bigint;

SELECT time, signal_name AS event, value::double precision AS value, lap_number FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND ('${lap_number}' = '-1' OR lap_number = '${lap_number}') AND ((signal_name = 'Recovery_Resumed' AND value = 1) OR (signal_name = 'Error_Count' AND value > 0)) AND time >= COALESCE((SELECT created_at FROM sessions WHERE uid::text = '${session_id}'), now() - interval '6 hours') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100;

list.definition: SELECT uid::text AS __value, COALESCE(session_name, uid::text) || ' | ' || to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

list.query: SELECT uid::text AS __value, COALESCE(session_name, uid::text) || ' | ' || to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM sessions ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT lap_number AS __value, ('Lap ' || lap_number::text) AS __text FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND lap_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lap_number::int;
list.label: Lap
list.name: lap_number
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT lap_number AS __value, ('Lap ' || lap_number::text) AS __text FROM telemetry_raw WHERE session_uid::text = '${session_id}' AND lap_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lap_number::int;
